purpose: Executable, tool-free successor to the provider-free v4 compatibility snapshot. It freezes three exact first-eight-question cells from v4 before contact and preserves sealed current Nous evidence as provisional breadth only.
limits: Every cell is a fresh root.
The callback writes one launch intent after revalidating the prepared root, current runtime, route proof, source bytes, prompt bytes, task-contract bytes, schedule, and schema.
Any exception after launch intent is terminal reconcile_required; no in-place resend is available.
A completion is always PROVISIONAL_BREADTH_ONLY, including when the sealed bridge evidence is valid.
